## 5. Power Skips (for height)

Exercise Objective: Develop explosive power in the lower body

## Procedure

1. Perform a high skip by driving the left knee up, maintaining a 90° angle at the knee, landing on the take-off leg (the extended leg)
2. Try to attain maximal height during every skip (-16)
3. Drive arms aggressively in opposition to the legs

## Coaching Points

- The take-off leg should reach full extension at the ankle, knee, and hip for every skip
- The goal should be to skip as high as possible, not as far as possible
